purpose: Search, filter, and select from an option list, with optional custom-value entry and grouped results.

notes: Use VeliProvider so field text, options, empty state, tooltip labels, and direction are localized consistently.

useWhen: Users need to filter a predefined list by typing before selecting.
A selection list is long, grouped, or may optionally accept custom values.

avoidWhen.situation: The option set is short and does not need text filtering.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use a non-editable selector or visible radio group.

avoidWhen.situation: Typed text performs a general content search rather than selecting a value.

supportedInteractions: Open the menu on focus or with the trigger
Keyboard option navigation and selection through React Aria
approvedPatterns: Compose ComboBox with ComboBoxItem and optional ComboBoxSection.
Provide textValue or aria-label for complex, icon-only, or render-function options.
Provide a useful empty state for no matching options.
Use description text normally and errorMessage when invalid.
limitations: Direct root child composition and style overrides are not supported.
className is intended for outer layout.
Custom values are accepted only when explicitly enabled.
accessibility: Uses React Aria ComboBox, Input, Button, Popover, and ListBox semantics.
Complex options require reliable accessible text for filtering, selected values, and screen readers.
Required, disabled, and invalid states are exposed through React Aria.
responsive: The popover tracks the field width and the option list scrolls when its maximum height is reached.
rtl: The field, placeholder, popover, options, and sections follow the active language and direction.
